fields.draft: Ku Endla ni Ku Tirhisa Compost
fields.uncertainty: Compost is retained as the familiar technical loanword; the title otherwise translates making and using directly.

fields.sourceEnglish: A compost heap cut open, showing alternating layers of dry brown material and fresh green material, heat rising from the middle, and an arrow showing it being turned.
fields.currentDraft: A compost heap cut open, showing alternating layers of dry brown material and fresh green material, heat rising from the middle, and an arrow showing it being turned.
fields.draft: Heap ya compost leyi pfuriweke hi le xikari, yi komba alternating layers ta dry brown material na fresh green material; ku hisa ku tlakuka ku suka exikarhini, naswona arrow yi komba leswaku heap ya hundzuluxiwa.
fields.literalBacktranslation: A compost heap opened in the middle, showing alternating layers of dry brown material and fresh green material; heat rises from the middle, and an arrow shows that the heap is being turned.
fields.uncertainty: Retains the alternating dry-brown/fresh-green layers, heat rising from the middle, and the turning arrow. 'Pfuriweke hi le xikari' means opened through the middle; heap, alternating layers, material types and arrow remain English for visual precision.

fields.sourceEnglish: Mulching and Cover Crops: Protecting and Building Soil
fields.currentDraft: Mulching and Cover Crops: Protecting and Building Soil
fields.draft: Ku Tirhisa Mulch na Cover Crops: Ku Sirhelela ni ku Aka Misava
fields.literalBacktranslation: Using Mulch and Cover Crops: Protecting and Building Soil
fields.uncertainty: Keeps mulch and cover crops as technical terms while translating protecting and building soil. The sense of building soil here remains broad, as in the source.

fields.sourceEnglish: Two patches of soil under the same sun: bare ground cracked and dry, mulched ground still dark and moist.
fields.currentDraft: Two patches of soil under the same sun: bare ground cracked and dry, mulched ground still dark and moist.
fields.draft: Swiphemu swimbirhi swa misava ehansi ka dyambu rin'we: misava leyi nga funengetiwangi yi pandzekile naswona yi omile; misava leyi nga na mulch ya ha ri ya ntima naswona yi tsakamile.
fields.literalBacktranslation: Two patches of soil under one sun: uncovered soil is cracked and dry; soil with mulch is still dark and moist.
fields.uncertainty: Preserves two patches, the same sun, cracked/dry bare ground, and the mulched patch remaining dark and moist. Mulch stays English; no change to the visual comparison is intended.
